scope: Ordinary coach direct player-card replay. Reward remains separate.

dose.law: B_lo = C_GLOBAL * A(age) * N / p; B_hi = upperDoseRatio * B_lo
dose.primaryPrediction: C_GLOBAL is frozen before replay. No observed coach preview from the scored player is used to calibrate amplitude.
dose.pairedCoachCalibration: Deprecated as a primary validation method. Same-state anchor transfer may be retained only as a secondary mechanism diagnostic.

evaluation.primary: Direct prediction from player-card state plus coach metadata versus the observed game preview interval
evaluation.eligibility: One complete player card and one ordinary coach preview answer key are sufficient. A second coach output and an exact repeated state are not required.
alsoReport: coverage by player, family and evidence provenance
evaluation.leakageRule: Observed preview endpoints are answer keys only and must not affect prediction parameters for that row or player.

evidenceBoundary: Observed screenshot ranges are answer keys; frozen assistant predictions are never answer keys.
Primary prediction uses player-card inputs age, tier, stat value and display class plus coach multiplier/family/affected-stat count.
Single-event players are valid empirical tests; repeated coach outputs are optional diagnostics.
State identifiers are provenance labels, not eligibility gates.
Reward is excluded from ordinary transfer scoring.
Programme/family effects are not silently fitted; results are stratified by family.
Incomplete player-card records remain inventoried and quarantined by missing field rather than disappearing from corpus coverage.
